result.title: Powering Agentic AI with AI-Ready Data Platforms That Turn Data Into Intelligence
result.description: In this NVIDIA GTC Taipei session, NVIDIA VP of Storage Technology Jason Hardy shares how we are working with leading partners to build a new class of AI-native data platforms that tightly integrate accelerated compute, high-performance storage, intelligent data services, and built-in security into a unified architecture — enabling data to be prepared, secured, and served in place so intelligent agents can operate with real-time context and drive faster outcomes from proof of concept to production.

result.title: NVIDIA & Wistron: Reindustrializing America With Advanced Manufacturing
result.description:
NVIDIA founder and CEO Jensen Huang joined Wistron Chairman Simon Lin in Fort Worth, Texas to discuss how AI infrastructure is reshaping U.S. advanced manufacturing.

Wistron's first U.S. manufacturing facility is producing the NVIDIA GB300 Grace Blackwell Ultra Superchip and will produce the NVIDIA Vera Rubin Superchip.

Learn more about how building AI at scale supports supply chains and skilled workers, powering the next industrial chapter for America.

result.title: Turning Compute Into Data for Physical AI With NVIDIA Cosmos
result.description:
The real world is infinite and unpredictable. Physical AI needs data—but real-world data is impossible to scale.

Meet NVIDIA Cosmos—the frontier of physical AI. Built on a new mixture-of-transformers architecture, this open omnimodel brings together pixels, actions, sound, and language to reason, plan, and generate what comes next. 

Developers can post-train Cosmos across embodiments and use cases. It can understand the physical world, generate physics-aware synthetic video, and simulate plausible futures and with post-training- Cosmos becomes a world action model that perceives, reasons, plans, and generates actions. Now available in multiple sizes.
